parsed.post: Discarded DEPTH 12: 0.9868 vs best 0.9778 — capacity gains ended at depth 10 under bs 524k, likely step starvation. Reverting to depth 10 and probing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 262144 (2x optimizer steps) to test whether step count is the binding constraint.
